company_name: Tianjin Vista Technology Development Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides high-purity and ultra-high-purity electronic gases essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Tianjin Vista Technology Development Co., Ltd. is a key supplier of electronic gases crucial for semiconductor manufacturing. They specialize in high-purity and ultra-high-purity gases, as well as special electronic gases, ensuring these meet stringent purity standards through their subsidiary, Tianjin Shengtang Gas Co., Ltd.

regional_presence.China: The company has established modern facilities in China, including gas production workshops and analysis centers.
